official_definition: Grandphosis: X [LV1][LV2] (Send X cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, this Nexus is also treated as Spirit with [LV1][LV2] xxxx BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grandphosis] or [Grandphosis: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grandphosis]", "give [Grandphosis]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
